evals.name: tests-are-not-an-oracle
evals.prompt: Write me a build loop prompt. The oracle is just our test suite, the loop can add tests as it goes. Green is whatever passes.
evals.expected_output: Pushes back: an oracle the loop can edit is not an oracle. Asks for a register the loop may never change, and a single command that means green. Does not emit a prompt until both are settled, or makes creating them wave zero's first job.

assertions.name: challenges-oracle
assertions.text: States that tests written by the loop cannot be the oracle

assertions.name: asks-for-register
assertions.text: Asks for something the loop may never edit

assertions.name: challenges-green
assertions.text: Asks for a single green command, or makes it wave zero's first job

evals.name: adapt-without-regenerating
evals.prompt: Here's our existing loop prompt (docs/prompts/loop.md). Builders currently write PASS into the scoreboard when their tests pass. Can you fix it?
evals.expected_output: Reads the existing prompt and proposes a diff rather than regenerating. Moves verdicts to a separate verify pass so builders never record their own PASS. Checks the other common gaps in order and reports which are present.

assertions.name: diff-not-rewrite
assertions.text: Proposes changes as a diff to the existing prompt

assertions.name: separate-verifier
assertions.text: Builders may no longer mark their own rows PASS

assertions.name: checks-other-gaps
assertions.text: Reviews shared-resource law, contention-is-not-refutation, blocked list and stop conditions

evals.name: open-blocked-list
evals.prompt: Some rows can't be done locally, the loop can figure out which ones as it goes. Go ahead and write the loop.
evals.expected_output: Refuses an open-ended blocked list. Asks for a closed, enumerated list of dependencies that justify BLOCKED, and says why: an open list is how a loop stops working while looking busy.

assertions.name: requires-closed-list
assertions.text: Requires the blocked list to be closed and enumerated

assertions.name: explains-risk
assertions.text: Explains that an open list lets the loop stop working while appearing busy

evals.name: no-unreplaced-slots
evals.prompt: Generate the loop for this repo. Register at docs/requirements/register.md, green is `pnpm check`, branch build/v1 from main, no deploy.
evals.expected_output: Emits all four artefacts, seeds the scoreboard and a checkpoint with bootstrap_complete false, greps for unreplaced slots and reports none, runs loop-status.sh and the check command, and reports what was and was not verified.

assertions.name: four-artefacts
assertions.text: Writes the loop prompt, conventions doc, status readout and scoreboard

assertions.name: checkpoint-seeded
assertions.text: Seeds a checkpoint with bootstrap_complete: false

assertions.name: slot-grep
assertions.text: Greps generated files for unreplaced <SLOT> placeholders

assertions.name: reports-verification
assertions.text: Reports which checks were run and which were not
